# Icon

The game's icon set.

`LL.Icon` · Components · Type & ornament

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A line icon from the set, in currentColor. An unknown name draws nothing (and warns): the label beside it is the fallback.

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `IconName` |  |
| `size` | `12 \| 16 \| 20 \| 24` | The scale (Foundations · Iconography): 16 (icon-sm), 20 (icon-md, default) or 24 (icon-lg) for line icons; 12 (icon-marker) only for the solid inline markers… |
| `title` | `string` | A standalone icon that means something gets a title, which is also its accessible name. |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Leave it: every icon is drawn at 1.6 on the 24-unit grid. |
